policy: Portable path rewrites and explicit bundle custody bindings were applied. Scenario parameters, planner identity, metrics, events, and replay outcomes were preserved.

validation.jsonl_source_record_comparison: All 74 path-normalized JSONL records were checked against their source bytes during transformation; each differs only in scenario_params.route_overrides_file. Exact original producer bytes for all 64 pilot candidate episode records were recovered from the retained pre-normalization evidence commit and are now included under payload/source_episode_records/. Their SHA-256 and byte counts match the producer bindings. The 64 path-normalized copies used by the schema-v3 report are under payload/path_normalized_episode_records/. Other replay and smoke JSONL artifacts retain their recorded exact-byte counterparts.
validation.provenance_source_record_comparison: All five final provenance records are bound by source and normalized SHA-256. They reflect the original path rewrites, a raw_artifacts[0].sha256 rebind to the path-normalized recorded episode, and the listed bundle-only producer/retention annotations. The original provenance files are not included in the durable bundle.
validation.provenance_bundle_binding_hashes: normalized_sha256 values bind the final tracked provenance bytes after producer-path and exact-copy retention annotations were added.

candidate_episode_record_retention.producer_sha256_and_size_bindings: source_sha256_before_path_normalization and source_size_bytes bind exact producer bytes; producer_bytes_retained_path identifies each retained source file.
candidate_episode_record_retention.normalized_sha256_and_size_bindings: sha256, normalized_sha256, and size_bytes in the same maps
candidate_episode_record_retention.route_path_policy: Use the repo-relative producer_output_path-derived route_overrides.yaml path; candidate-specific route inputs are not bundled for every case, and report generation does not dereference this field.
